EmailTemplate.subject: ON THE FLY: The Support Journey
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Success is attributed to positive experiences. As an organization that prides itself on being experience-centric, we believe adding value in the moment for current and future users is what takes traditional 'support' functions to the next level.
In our latest blog <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/delivering-valuable-experiences-three-ways-to-ensure-success-at-every-step-of-the-support-journey?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>, Jon Stamper, Flywire's Director of Client & Payment Experience, describes three ways Flywire works to ensure valuable support experiences.
